public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs trained on next-token prediction doing a pretty good job at a variety of natural language tasks, and very recently a considerably less good job at tasks combining text with images, is certainly interesting but does not justify the claim that they constitute general intelligence.

statement.excerpt: The fact that LLMs trained on the task of next-token prediction can also do a pretty good job at a variety of natural language tasks, and, very recently, a considerably less good job of tasks that combine text with images, as emphasized by Agüera y Arcas and Norvig is certainly interesting, but it doesn’t justify the claim that they constitute “general intelligence”.
statement.document_title: Reports of the birth of AGI are greatly exaggerated
